study_schedule.source_excerpt: Protocol sections 7.1.2-7.1.4 and 6: trial period boundaries, treatment schedules, and key secondary endpoints; per-visit panels are listed but table content is absent from supplied text: "Trial ID: LP0160-1396 Date: 05-Oct-2021 Version: 6.0" "The trial consists of a screening period of 2 to 4 weeks (Week -4/-2 to Week 0)," "an induction period of 12 weeks (Week 0 to Week 12), a maintenance period of" "40 weeks (Week 12 to Week 52), and a safety follow-up period of 8 weeks" "(Week 52 to Week 60)." "Induction period from Week 0 to Week 12" "Subjects randomised at Week 0 to brodalumab or any of the 2 placebo arms" "will receive injections at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10." "Subjects randomised at Week 0 to ustekinumab will receive injections at" "Weeks 0 and 4." "Maintenance period from Week 12 to Week 52" "Subjects randomised at Week 0 to either brodalumab or ustekinumab will" "continue on the allocated treatment until Week 52:" "• Subjects on brodalumab treatment will receive injections every 2 weeks" "from Week 12 to Week 50." "• Subjects on ustekinumab treatment will receive injections at Weeks 16, 28," "and 40." "Subjects randomised to placebo followed by brodalumab will switch to" "brodalumab treatment during the maintenance period and receive brodalumab" "injections at Weeks 12, 13, 14, and then every 2 weeks until Week 50." "Subjects randomised to placebo followed by ustekinumab will switch to" "ustekinumab treatment during the maintenance period and will receive" "ustekinumab injections at Weeks 12, 16, 28, and 40." "Safety follow-up period from Week 52 to Week 60" "The subjects will be followed until Week 60." "The 8-week follow-up period" "The brodalumab arm and the 2 placebo arms will be double-blinded until" "Week 12 and the ustekinumab arm will be open-label throughout the entire" "The trial will be unblinded after Week 12, but the efficacy assessments" "will be performed by an investigator who is blinded to the treatment allocation" "(PASI) score from baseline (PASI 75 response), assessed at Week 12." "Week 12." "• sPGA score of 0, assessed at Week 12." "• PASI 90 response, assessed at Week 12." "• PASI 100 response, assessed at Week 12." "Panel 2: Schedule of trial procedures for screening and induction period ..............................." "Panel 3: Schedule of trial procedures for maintenance and safety follow-up periods ............." -- The only posted protocol is dated 05-Oct-2021 (Version 6). It distinguishes screening (2 to 4 weeks, not a fixed duration), induction, maintenance, and safety follow-up. The supplied protocol text identifies Panels 2 and 3 as schedules of trial procedures but does not include their per-visit table content; this schedule is supported by the narrative sections. Injection schedules differ by active and crossover arms and are represented in the cited text rather than generalized into one interval. Key secondary endpoint assessments are stated at Week 12.

value.applies_to_period: All four treatment arms from Week 4 onward during treatment.
value.rationale: Protocol section 7.1.3 permits investigator-selected WHO class I-IV topical corticosteroid rescue from Week 4 onward for an increase of at least 25% in PASI from baseline.

rescue_therapy.source_excerpt: Protocol section 7.1.3 rescue treatment; clinical rescue rule: "Rescue treatment" "From Week 4 and after, rescue treatment with topical corticosteroids (class I to" "IV, according to World Health Organization [WHO] classification of topical" "corticosteroids, as deemed appropriate by the investigator) is allowed in all" "4 treatment arms in subjects with an increase of ≥25% in PASI score from" "baseline (Week 0)." -- This field cites the protocol for the clinical rescue permission. Superseded analysis-handling assertions are left null.

discontinuation_due_to_ae_rate.source_excerpt: resultsSection.participantFlowModule.periods[0] (Overall Study): the posted dropWithdraws reasons (Study early termination, Withdrawal by Subject) account for every non-completer in every group (Brodalumab: STARTED 2, NOT COMPLETED 2 = sum of dropWithdraws 2; Ustekinumab: STARTED 6, NOT COMPLETED 6 = sum of dropWithdraws 6; Placebo/Brodalumab: STARTED 2, NOT COMPLETED 2 = sum of dropWithdraws 2; Placebo/Ustekinumab: STARTED 2, NOT COMPLETED 2 = sum of dropWithdraws 2) and none is an adverse event -- so 0 discontinuations due to AE per group in this period is a complete, computed count, not an assumed zero.
